4.name: teach_me
4.definition: I believe this could teach me something
paraphrases: I want to see how others handle it
It would show me what to do
It could help me fix a problem in my life

5.name: teach_others
5.definition: I believe this could teach other people something.
paraphrases: this could show viewers how to handle it

6.name: shift_my_feelings
6.definition: It would make me feel more understood and less alone.
paraphrases: this would make me feel seen

7.name: shift_others_feelings
7.definition: It could change how other people feel.
paraphrases: many viewers would connect with it
it could help people understand an experience

8.name: societal_change
8.definition: This could change culture, politics, or society.

9.name: authenticity
9.definition: This is a more authentic depiction.
paraphrases: current shows don't include this enough
this reflects what’s happening in society
it shows real issues people face
it’s an honest depiction of reality
